inspector.noPreset.title: No model is configured for the journal
inspector.noPreset.body: pick an ai preset the journal can use. until then the day shows only what was measured, without written cards.

evidence.empty: no evidence rows are stored for this card. the source frames may have been deleted by retention.
evidence.sampled: evidence is sampled — at most 24 rows, evenly spaced across the card.

now.stalledReason: no fresh capture in the last few minutes, so the relation is not judged.
status.empty_but_recording.title: nothing written yet
status.empty_but_recording.body: recording is on and this day has no finished cards yet. they appear as windows of work complete.
status.no_capture_in_range.title: no capture for this day
status.no_capture_in_range.body: nothing was recorded between 4am and 4am, so there is nothing to write about.
status.not_recording.title: recording is off
status.not_recording.body: the journal reads what screenpipe captured. turn recording on to fill the next day.
status.unknown.title: state unknown
status.unknown.body: the engine could not tell whether this day was captured. try again in a moment.
status.ok.title: no cards for this day
status.ok.body: the day was captured but produced no activity cards.
week.error.title: The week could not be read
settings.journal.intro: The journal writes a read-only day from what screenpipe captured. It runs locally and calls whichever model preset you pick below.
settings.journal.enabled.title: Enable journal
settings.journal.enabled.description: Turn the background writer on or off. Existing days stay readable.
settings.journal.model.title: Journal model
settings.journal.model.description: The AI preset used to write cards. Local presets keep every call on this machine.
settings.journal.profile.title: Work profile
settings.journal.profile.description: Given to the writer so it can name your projects instead of guessing. Stored on this device.
settings.journal.profile.rolePlaceholder: what you do, in your own words
settings.journal.profile.notesPlaceholde: anything the writer should know about your days
settings.journal.categories.title: Categories
settings.journal.categories.description: The list the writer classifies each card against. System rows cannot be renamed or removed.
settings.journal.preset.custom: This list is your own. Picking a role replaces it.
settings.journal.preset.confirmBody: This replaces the {current} editable categories you have now with the {next} below. Idle and other system rows are kept. Past cards keep the category they were written with.
settings.journal.nudges.title: Focus nudges
settings.journal.nudges.description: Notify when work has diverged from your stated intention. Off by default.
settings.journal.grace.title: Grace period
settings.journal.grace.description: How long a divergence must last before it is classified at all.
settings.journal.regenerate.title: Regenerate today
settings.journal.regenerate.description: Queue today's windows to be written again. Cards are replaced as each window finishes.
settings.journal.regenerate.queued: {count, plural, one {# window} other {# windows}} queued for rewrite.

onboarding.acquisition.title: how did you find screenpipe?
onboarding.acquisition.subtitle: one tap. it helps us know where to show up.
onboarding.permissions.title: Unlock the full experience
onboarding.permissions.subtitle: Three permissions turn on recording.
onboarding.permissions.mic.title: Capture what you say
onboarding.permissions.mic.subtitle: Lets Screenpipe transcribe your voice in meetings and calls
onboarding.permissions.accessibility.sub: Lets Screenpipe understand app content without OCR
onboarding.permissions.screen.title: Capture your screen
onboarding.permissions.screen.subtitle: Lets Screenpipe index what's on your screen: windows, docs, chats, code.
onboarding.permissions.restart.title: restart required
onboarding.permissions.restart.body: screenpipe won't work until you restart.
onboarding.timeline.title: meet the timeline
onboarding.timeline.subtitle: rewind what you've seen on screen
onboarding.timeline.cost.screenshots: takes periodic screenshots as you work
onboarding.timeline.cost.bounds: skips incognito windows. you can exclude any app in settings.
onboarding.timeline.lowTier.title: timeline may slow down this device
onboarding.timeline.lowTier.body: keeping it off saves memory, cpu and disk. text exposed by your apps stays searchable; screenshots and image-only text won't be captured.
onboarding.timeline.error: couldn't save that choice. check disk space and try again.
onboarding.timeline.footnote: not a forever choice — change it anytime in settings
onboarding.role.title: What do you mostly do?
onboarding.role.subtitle: Your journal sorts each day into categories. Pick the closest match and we will start from those.
onboarding.role.footnote: Not a forever choice — edit the categories anytime in settings.
onboarding.engine.cpuCompat: compatibility mode: this CPU lacks AVX2 — local whisper transcription is unavailable (cloud + parakeet engines still work)
onboarding.engine.permissionBody: macOS tracks this permission per app signature. if you switched between prod / beta / dev builds, your previous grant doesn't carry over — each bundle id has its own record.
